changes: Allowed every Hope-cost character feature to be activated with the same amount of Effort as an alternative payment.
Added explicit Hope and Effort action buttons to executable Ancestry, Class, Community and Hope-feature cards.
Applied the same Hope-or-Effort choice to Domain Card powers without changing their canonical numeric cost.
Recorded the selected resource payment in local Roll History and Firebase table-wide callouts.
Converted Player Tool weapons into a persistent arsenal and multi-weapon loadout with active-weapon switching.
Connected weapon traits and canonical feature definitions to attack rolls, including Reliable, Accurate, Heavy, Massive, Brutal and Paired mechanics.
Added structured weapon effects, resistance/DC notes, damage-die details and modifier breakdowns to roll callouts and history.
Replaced long ancestry, class, community and path feature paragraphs with compact operational cards and executable roll/resource actions.
Applied active Massive weapon Evasion penalties while retaining the editable base Evasion value.
Preserved legacy and RC2 character imports with three Experiences and complete weapon arsenals.
Restored the two Player Tool background assets that were omitted from the consolidated deployment package.
Added a fixed viewport-level Back/Next dock so character-creation progression remains available without scrolling.
Moved required Ailuran sub-strain and class subclass choices into custom in-app overlays; cancelling the overlay cancels the parent selection.
Redesigned trait assignment to support trait-first or value-first selection, direct swaps, drag-and-drop, progress feedback and reset.
Expanded starting Experiences from two to three and updated save, load, migration, validation and generated character-sheet output.
Removed the obsolete Character Sheet secondary Player/Keeper navigation so portal.js is the only site-level navigation.
Reduced the digital Character Sheet toolbar by hiding duplicate Creator, Mode, Downloads/Feedback and Account controls while retaining the underlying code for future reactivation.
Restored the fillable two-page physical character-sheet PDF to the Downloads manifest.
Aligned shared navigation, page spacing, panels, fields and Character Sheet toolbar surfaces for stronger cross-module visual cohesion.
Removed native horizontal scrollbar chrome from Player Tool controls and replaced portal navigation overflow with VeilFarers scroll buttons.
Added a shared application-owned scrollbar and control skin across portal pages.
Restored the full original Keeper and Player playtest questionnaire catalogue on the Feedback page while retaining direct Netlify Forms feedback.
Added current Netlify Identity admin-role assignment guidance to the Administration page.
Restored reliable table-wide roll callouts using unique broadcast event IDs instead of client-clock-only freshness checks.
Broadcast Keeper duality and d20 rolls from the main dice roller, in addition to damage and ability events.
Added explicit damage dice, individual results, modifiers and final totals to Player and Keeper roll histories.
Improved Firestore snapshot compatibility and duplicate-callout suppression across reconnects.
Restored the complete v58 character sheet and editable/print-ready physical PDF exports.
Added canonical Creator-to-sheet synchronization and retained legacy character JSON import.
Fixed ancestry, class and community feature import in Player Tool.
Fixed Domain Cards modal sizing and readability.
Replaced the invalid Advanced tech tier with Precursor.
Added Wealth Tier labels to all catalogue costs.
Unified Player and Keeper navigation and added a persistent Netlify Identity status button.
Migrated Player Tool domain cards to the shared 11.1-RC2-draft6 powers collection and removed the embedded Corebook 10.x rules file.
Added direct import and persistent local continuity between the RC2 Character Creator draft and Player Tool.
Replaced Keeper Tool embedded equipment tables with live canonical RC2 weapons, armor, augmentations and feature definitions from /rules-data.
Replaced the Keeper Tool hardcoded client password with a Netlify Identity gate accepting keeper or admin roles.
Added canonical-runtime.js as the shared asynchronous adapter for Player Tool and Keeper Tool.
Validated canonical runtime counts and Creator-to-Player mapping; removed the now-unused veilfarers-data.js legacy asset.
Added the normalized RC2 data bundle under /rules-data as the shared canonical application layer.
Implemented functional Weapon & Armory and Item Inventory catalogues with filters, stable IDs, shared local inventory, and JSON import/export.
Removed obsolete 11.0.3 download links and published only the four 11.1 RC2 PDF candidates.
Moved account and RC2 character vault management to the dedicated Netlify Identity Log-in page.
Added a character-sheet bridge that reads the RC2 creator draft and shared equipment inventory.
Activated Netlify Forms feedback intake and expanded the role-gated administrator diagnostics.
Preserved Firebase runtime configuration through /api/firebase-config without embedding environment values.
Replaced provisional homepage with the RC2 Draft 5 Character Creator.
Kept the RC2 Card Library integrated in the same canonical application.
Preserved RC2 creator data and artwork as the canonical source.
Added portal navigation and RC2 PDF downloads.
